stem: Which one of the following statements is not correct about the ‘Battle of Ten Kings’?

options.A: It was fought between Bharatas and the Purus on the banks of river Parushini
options.B: Bharatas were headed by Purukutsa while the Purus were led by the Sudas
options.C: Bharatas emerged victorious despite the help given to the Purus by several other tribes
options.D: The victorious Bharatas and Vanquished Purus later combined to form the ‘Kurus’
